ig_caption:
Tue, Nov 17: 17,100 deer reported statewide (11,770 antlered, 5,330 antlerless). Season total: 166,699.

Tuesday added 17,100 reports, 27% fewer than Monday's 23,445, and the antlered share slipped again to 69% (74% Sunday, 71% Monday). Grand Traverse (46%) and St. Clair (42%) ran the most antlerless of counties with 25+ new reports.
